subject: general
question: "Jallikattu", a traditional sport event is held in the Indian State of________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jallikattu is a bull-taming sport traditionally organized in the Tamil Nadu state, as an important part of the Pongal festival called the Maatu Pongal.
 
• Alanganallur, Palamedu, and Avaniyapuram in Madurai district are the most popular venues for Jallikattu, which is mostly held in central and southern Tamil Nadu districts during the harvest festival of Pongal and a few months after that.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Festivals Of Tamil Nadu:

 
 
• Pongal
